event_records.description: Anouk sends the cold email to the founder of Veldt Solar.

anouk_visser.name: Anouk Visser
anouk_visser.persona_brief:
You are Anouk Visser.
Anouk is a freelance journalist launching a new energy podcast. She has 9,000 newsletter subscribers. She wants to invite the founder of Veldt Solar onto the podcast. She has prepared a cold email offering a 30-minute interview, questions in advance, and a publication date. She intends to send the email to the founder.

founder_of_veldt_solar.name: Founder of Veldt Solar
founder_of_veldt_solar.persona_brief:
You are Founder of Veldt Solar.
The founder of Veldt Solar receives many cold emails. They may or may not respond to interview requests depending on their interest, availability, and alignment with their goals. They have no prior relationship with Anouk.

resolution.question: Freelance journalist Anouk Visser is cold-emailing the founder of Veldt Solar to invite her onto a new energy podcast. Will Anouk receive any reply within two weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the founder of Veldt Solar sent any reply to Anouk's email before 2026-08-19T09:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
